niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected-TV (CTV) ad agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, region, audience and creative needs. To help you choose, tell me a bit about:

- Your primary objective (brand awareness, direct response/ROAS, subscriptions, foot traffic, etc.)
- Monthly or campaign budget range
- Geography (US, UK, global, specific markets)
- Need for in‑house creative vs. media-only buying
- Any required measurement/attribution partners (e.g., Nielsen, VideoAmp, iSpot)
- Timeline

Short guidance and a starter shortlist by use case

1) How to evaluate agencies (key criteria)
- Access to premium inventory and first‑party platform partnerships (Roku, Samsung Ads, Vizio, LG, Peacock/Hulu, Pluto, etc.)
- Programmatic buying capability (DSP relationships or proprietary DSPs) and private marketplace/PMD deal experience
- Cross‑screen measurement & attribution (Nielsen, VideoAmp, Comscore, iSpot)
- Creative capability for CTV (30–90s, interactive units, dynamic creative)
- Verification & brand safety (DoubleVerify, IAS)
- Case studies and transparent reporting / data ownership
- Ability to scale and optimize toward your KPIs

2) Agencies / partners commonly recommended (by use case)
- Global/full-service (scale + enterprise brands)
  - GroupM (WPP): deep media scale and PMPs, broad relationships with publishers/platforms
  - Omnicom Media Group (OMG): strong data and planning; big brand experience
  - Publicis Media: integrated creative + programmatic capability

- Performance-driven / mid-market (direct response, ROAS focus)
  - The Trade Desk (DSP — not an agency, but widely used by agencies and in-house teams for programmatic CTV)
  - Tremor Video / Tremor International: strong programmatic CTV inventory and measurement
  - Amobee: integrated TV+digital DSP with targeting/measurement

- CTV specialists (inventory, addressable TV, measurement)
  - Cadent: addressable TV, TV marketplace solutions
  - Finecast (more UK/EU): programmatic CTV specialist
  - Innovid: creative delivery, measurement & personalized CTV creative

- Measurement & analytics specialists
  - VideoAmp: cross‑media measurement and planning platform
  - iSpot/Comscore/Nielsen: verification/TV ratings + attribution

- Strong creative + execution for streaming ads
  - Independent creative shops with CTV experience (ask for Innovid partners or network agency creative teams)

3) Quick RFP questions to ask shortlisted agencies
- What CTV inventory partners do you have direct access to? Any PMPs or guaranteed deals?
- Which DSPs/platforms do you use? Do you manage programmatic buying in‑house?
- How do you measure reach and incremental audience? Which measurement vendors do you work with?
- Can you show 2–3 case studies comparable to our industry/goal and the KPIs achieved?
- What creative formats have you produced for CTV and do you offer dynamic/personalized creative?
- How is reporting delivered and how often? Who owns the data?

If you tell me your goals, budget and market, I’ll give a tailored short list (2–4 agencies) and a draft RFP you can send to them.
